listing.name: Demand Indicators
listing.summary: This mod adds small icons next to commodities on a market to show if they have excess or shortages, making it easier to identify worthwhile trading opportunities at a glance. It's terrific QOL.
listing.aiSummary: Adds small icons next to commodities on a market to show if they have excess or shortages.

description:
Save Compatible

Manual Download
Requires LunaLib to edit settings, but will work fine without it

Dependencies are automatically downloaded when installing with TriOS
Older versions and changelogs

Or support me on Ko-Fi

This mod adds small icons next to commodities on a market to show if they have excess or shortages, making it easier to identify worthwhile trading opportunities at a glance. It's terrific QOL.

Low visibility mode (toggle this on in the settings, requires LunaLib)

To install the mod, simply download the .zip file from the link above, unzip it in your Starsector mods directory, and enable it in the launcher.

This is safe to add to ongoing games, and it is safe to remove from ongoing games.

There are currently no known compatibility issues with other mods.

Change Log
Changelog 1.0.d and onwards (Link)

1.0.c
Added - Indicators for high purchase volumes
Added - Indicators for price if there is no shortage/excess
Added - LunaLib option for low impact mode
Fixed - Marines got their rank back

1.0.b
Added - Initial Release

Attribution / Acknowledgement
ParrotParrot     Proposed the mod concept

Ask before using my code.

discordPostHtml:
Indicators showing excess or shortage directly next to the commodity icon

This mod adds small icons next to commodities on a market to show if they have excess or shortages, making it easier to identify worthwhile trading opportunities at a glance. It's terrific QOL.

Initially proposed by ParrotParrot.

Changelog:
1.0.f Added setting to invert the arrows
1.0.e Removed LunaLib Dependency (It is still required to edit the settings)
1.0.d Updated to new version
+ Save compatible + 
+ Can be installed on an ongoing save
This means: The mod can safely be added if it was not present on game start, and can be installed over any prior updates of the same mod.
